About Oncology Consulting
We provide consultations to veterinarians anywhere in the world, who are caring for animals of any species, with any type of cancer.
We will review case information in depth and provide a complete written report with recommendations and responses to specific questions. Please note that we are not able to advise pet owners or caregivers directly, because without the presence of a veterinarian / client / patient relationship, our recommendations would not be valid.
Initial Consultation
We will review case information in depth and provide a complete written report. A phone consultation can also be requested if needed.
Email $300, Phone $350 (note: a phone consultation involves an emailed consultation report followed by a phone consultation to discuss and is a phone call to the requesting veterinarian not the client/owner)
Follow-up –
Follow-up consultations for ongoing case management are $35 per contact
Chemotherapy protocol,
$50 – all chemotherapy protocols are customised for the individual patient.
Optional additional information sheets:
Information sheets on chemotherapy drug handling and administration, $15 each
Client information sheets on treatment type, protocol, and chemotherapy drugs, $15 each
Client information sheet on tumour type and behaviour, $15
We are happy to consult to veterinarians in any country. Although we are Australian-based, we consult to veterinarians in New Zealand, Singapore, Honk Kong, Malaysia, the USA, Canada, the UAE, and even Vanuatu (just to name a few!)
All fees are in
Australian dollars
, and for consultations inside Australia inclusive of Goods & Services Tax (GST) of 10%. For consultations inside Australia, payment can be made by direct bank transfer or credit card. For consultations outside Australia, payment is preferred by credit card in Australian dollars but direct transfer is also accepted (fees may apply).
Arranging a Consultation
Attention: if your clinic is not already an established client with us, please contact us directly at
[email protected]
prior to submitting a consultation request.
Please fill out and submit the online form. If you have any problem with the online form, please contact us directly at
[email protected]
A printable form is available if you would prefer this. If you would like the form for your records, please head to the downloads page or email us at
[email protected]
If applicable, send all test results and reports by email to
[email protected]
We will report back to you the same or next day during our
consulting hours
by your preferred method (phone or email) with recommendations and responses to any specific questions you have.
We will send you an invoice at the end of the month (
see fee schedule
).
Consultation Report Includes
What we include –
Diagnosis
Interpretation of current staging and bloodwork
Further staging required
Tumour behaviour and important prognostic factors
Prognosis for the patient with no further treatment
Treatment options:
Preferred treatment option
Primary treatment modality
Adjunctive treatment
Supportive treatment
Less costly treatment alternative
Palliative treatment alternative
Any additional comments
Attachments as requested:
Chemotherapy protocol, standardized or custom-designed, depending on the individual circumstances
Information sheets on chemotherapy drug handling and administration
Client information sheets on treatment type, protocol, and chemotherapy drugs
Client information sheet on tumour type and behaviour
Consulting Hours
Our consulting hours are 8 am to 3 pm (
New South Wales, Australia time
), Monday through Friday. You can submit a consultation request form on the website or by email at any time and we will respond by the end of our next consulting day. We look forward to helping you!
